rationale: Every artifact use of claim C-EVID-006 accurately reflects its scope and limitations. The claim states that 'Some saliency methods evaluated by Adebayo et al. were insensitive to model parameters or training-label structure, so visually plausible saliency output alone is not evidence of a faithful model explanation.' The claim's scope explicitly limits this to 'Selected saliency methods and visual-classification experiments; not a verdict on all interpretability methods.' All artifacts consistently use phrases like 'method-specific challenge,' 'one research-method limitation,' 'bounded method evidence,' and include explicit instructions not to overgeneralize or imply that all inspection is rejected. This careful phrasing and the inclusion of qualifiers ensure that the claim's findings are not extended beyond their stated boundaries.
